name: IEEE conference paper (US Letter)
description: Layout, typography and reference rules of the IEEE two-column conference template (US Letter).
notice: Built-in profile. Margins and columns were cross-checked against IEEE sample papers; the 10 pt body size is unverified. Always follow your conference's own template.
